channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Hackers raise refrigerator temperatures at hundreds of supermarkets
item.description: The cyberattack caused refrigerators to warm up in hundreds of stores, leading to fires and forcing spoiled food to be discarded.

item.title: Hurricane Simon strikes Mexico's Pacific coast, hitting resorts and towns
item.description: Simon weakened on Monday but continued to affect vulnerable areas along Mexico's Pacific Coast.

item.title: Kate Hudson welcomes Super Bowl back to Los Angeles in new video
item.description: Hudson appears in a new video ahead of the 2027 Super Bowl at SoFi Stadium, where a fan can win tickets through a giveaway.

item.title: Flash-flood risk persists in Southwest after Rachel's remnants hit Nevada
item.description: The National Weather Service has issued additional flood watches and warns of more showers and isolated thunderstorms in the Southwest following the remnants of Rachel.
